exposure: hypoglycemia during 50-g oral glucose challenge test (GCT)
outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 535 nulliparous cases from all live births at a single medical center between 2015 and 2019 with available 50-g GCT results and birth outcomes.
finding: Hypoglycemia during a 50-g GCT was significantly associated with lower birth weight.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in the mode of delivery between the hypoglycemic and normal GCT groups.
birth_weight: Hypoglycemic group: 3222 +/- 566 g; Normal GCT group: 3340 +/- 410 g
